records.Japanese:
聞けば、ポルトガル人には
ずいぶんひどい目に遭わされたらしい
でも、病人は病人だとまるで家族の
ように心配してくれまして…
records.current_English:
I heard the Portuguese had treated 
 them terribly. But to them, a sick 
 person was a sick person. They 
 cared for me as if I were family...
records.speaker: Manuel Almeida
records.context: Manuel explains why Sao Jorge is his second home, linking the townspeople's kindness and his faith to his pledge to fight slavers.
records.source_meaning: He reports what he heard about their mistreatment and makes clear that they still cared for him as they would for family.

という主のお教えを、身にしみて
感じましたよ。以来、ここは私の
第２の故郷となったんです
records.current_English:
That's when the Lord's teaching, 
 'Love your neighbor,'
 really sank in. This place 
 has been my second home ever since.
records.speaker: Manuel Almeida
